theory_and_hamiltonian_field.squozen_truth_axiom:
THE SQUOZEN TRUTH (MECH-COGNITIVE DUALITY THEOREM):
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Let M be a language model with parameter manifold Theta and vocabulary V.
Structural boundary invariants (markdown fences, delimiter balance, EOS placement, budget closure)
occupy high-entropy boundary basins in the generation simplex Delta^|V|.

1. Training Theta to avoid these boundary violations (via RLHF/DPO) compresses semantic representation,
   steals attention heads, and remains probabilistic: P(structural leakage) > 0.
2. Erecting an infinite potential barrier V(x) -> +inf (logits processor score -> -inf)
   at the boundary mechanically guarantees zero structural leakage (fences, delimiter mismatches, EOS/budget).
   Grammar and semantic validity beyond these structural boundaries remain empirical.
3. [Conjecture] By the Conservation of Cognitive Bandwidth, removing structural policing from Theta
   maximizes the Fisher Information Metric of the model weights on semantic reasoning.
CONCLUSION: Mechanism governs structure; Neural weights govern meaning.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

epistemic_scope.mechanically_guaranteed: zero backticks, delimiter balance, EOS placement, budget-safe closure.
epistemic_scope.empirically_observed: 100% json.loads success on this model, this prompt set, these budgets.
epistemic_scope.disclaimed: does not police semantic content, base model hallucination, or unmasked invalid JSON sequences (e.g. {'a' 1}, 01, tru, invalid escapes). closer_fired=True signifies truncated-but-parseable syntax, not semantic completeness.
